decisions.quote: One of the early studies supporting his model was conducted by Victorina Lefebvre. Over the years, other studies have been conducted, but not all have shown similar support as the original findings of Victorina Lefebvre. This study attempted to extend her findings in testing whether or not other ambiguous stimuli could be used in support of the model.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. The supplied primary source (29cbe0ff7f624a59.txt) contains only the title ('Asymmetry in Human Cognition: Further Replication and Extension'), author list, and a five-sentence abstract, with no full text or reference list. Contrary to Luna's triage disposal as not_a_target, unseen full text cannot be used to exclude a paper whose title explicitly describes it as a 'Further Replication and Extension'. However, because only the abstract is available, all citation fields in the blind target are empty and the evidence cannot resolve the precise questions of: (1) whether the full text empirically retests a specific published finding in addition to testing new ambiguous stimuli, (2) what the source-backed bibliographic citation is for Victorina Lefebvre's study, and (3) whether under the codebook's replication-chain rule the retested target is already represented by shipped row 2121 (Anderson & Grice, 2009, 'Replicating a Simple Study of Asymmetry in Human Cognition', Perceptual and Motor Skills, 109(2), 577-580, doi_o: 10.2466/pms.109.2.577-580, by the same first author James A. Anderson) or is an unshipped work by Victorina Lefebvre.
